name: Mantronix
hook: A DJ-and-MC duo who taught themselves the TR-808 in one studio session and built a whole style of hip-hop around programming it directly.
blurb: Kurtis Mantronik (the DJ) and MC Tee (the rapper) released 'Fresh Is the Word' in 1985, programming its beat on a Roland TR-808 that Mantronik taught himself to use in a single studio session. Their electro-funk records were built almost entirely from programmed drums, synth bass and a vocoded or synthesized voice, leaning harder on the drum machine and less on live instruments than most rap of the time, in layered rhythms that were compared then to West African log-drumming patterns. MC Tee left after their third album in 1988. Mantronik kept the group going, moving toward straight dance music in 1990 and 1991 before the name went quiet, and later brought it back for solo and reunion work.
